children.name: Offset Into Media Object Length Type
Offset Into Media Object Length Type

findings.message: Stream 1 is encrypted, so its media objects cannot be analyzed; the stream is described by its header.
The Content Encryption Object at 0xF0 is 42 bytes, too few for its fields; they are read as far as they go.
The file is protected by Microsoft Digital Rights Manager version 1; its streams are encrypted and are reported as the file holds them.
